title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gvfs security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for gvfs, the GNOME Desktop Virtual File System layer, addressing two vulnerabilities: a heap-based buffer overflow in the SFTP read_reply() function (CVE-2026-84268) and a race condition in gvfs-admin socket ownership that permits local root escalation (CVE-2026-88924). These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 across multiple architectures. An update is available to fix these vulnerabilities.
